documented_probe: C-4f1f7a1d (implement a runnable mips ELF interpreter): covered at hard difficulty; the verifier re-executes the JS VM on the visible sample plus six hidden big-endian MIPS32 images (arithmetic/hi-lo, recursion, live delay slots, byte/halfword ops, unsupported opcode, out-of-range memory) checking byte-exact stdout and exact exit statuses.
notes: Single deliverable: a pure-Node ELF loader + MIPS32 decoder/emulator for big-endian images with branch delay slots, hi/lo multiply-divide state, a custom print/exit syscall ABI, and precise error exit codes. Hidden cases include two malformed-image probes (unsupported opcode -> 2, out-of-range memory -> 7) and graceful failure on non-ELF input. Rubric weights reasoning_depth (delay-slot pipeline semantics, signed/unsigned edge cases), hidden_case_generalization, adversarial_inputs, and quantitative_correctness (byte-exact stdout + exit statuses); totals bucket to hard.
